_comment_purpose: Chest GUI background overlay font. The plugin's MenuTitleDecorator prepends a 3-character sandwich to every chest menu title — a -8px space (shift left to the panel origin), a row-count-specific bitmap glyph (paints the full-size chest panel PNG), and a -169px space (return cursor to the vanilla title position). Vanilla chests and other plugins' inventories are unaffected because they don't use this font.
_comment_codepoints: U+E100..U+E101 are the negative-space glyphs (panel-origin shift + title-restore). U+E110..U+E115 are the chest-background bitmaps, one per row count 1..6. Heights are the exact vanilla chest UI heights so the bitmap covers the whole panel edge to edge; ascent=13 puts the bitmap's top at y=0 of the chest (baseline at y=13 minus ascent of 13).
